dialogue.content: (こんにちは、今日はよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.English: (Hello, thank you for your time today.)

dialogue.content: (こんにちわ　どうぞ宜しくお願い致します)
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for seeing me.)

dialogue.content: (少し早いですが、始めさせていただいても大丈夫ですか？）
dialogue.English: (It's a little early, but would it be alright if we begin?)

dialogue.content: (はい　大丈夫です)
dialogue.English: (Yes, that's fine.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 今年の春に結婚を控えているのですが、
dialogue.English: I'm getting married this spring, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 体調が思わしくなくて　結婚を迷っています
dialogue.English: I haven't been feeling well, and I'm having second thoughts about the wedding.

dialogue.content: 体調不良だと気持ちも落ち込みますね。。。詳しくお話伺いたいのでお名前、ご年齢、性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Not feeling well can really bring your spirits down, can't it... To better understand your situation, could you please tell me your name, age, and gender?

dialogue.content: 名前はゆみです　２８才　女性です
dialogue.English: My name is Yumi, I'm 28 years old, and I'm female.

dialogue.content: 由美さん、ありがとうございます。ご結婚まであと2か月くらいですか？どんな風にお体の調子が悪いのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you, Yumi. Is your wedding in about two months? In what ways have you been feeling unwell?

dialogue.content: 最近　ダルさが続いてて顔色がわるいなぁと思っていました　化粧もうまくのらないし
dialogue.English: Lately, I've been feeling sluggish and I've noticed my complexion looks poor. My makeup doesn't go on well either.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 食事もとって１時間もたたないうちに気分が悪くなってきます
dialogue.English: And I feel nauseous less than an hour after I eat.

dialogue.content: 朝も目覚めが悪い日が多いです
dialogue.English: Many mornings, I also have trouble waking up feeling refreshed.

dialogue.content: それはお辛いですね。。。病院には行かれましたか？
dialogue.English: That sounds tough... Have you been to see a doctor?

dialogue.content: はい去年の暮れに行ってきました
dialogue.English: Yes, I went at the end of last year.

dialogue.content: では現在治療中と言う事ですか？先生は何ておっしゃいます？
dialogue.English: So, are you currently undergoing treatment? What did the doctor say?

dialogue.content: 治療とまではいってません　血液検査をしてみたのですが
dialogue.English: I'm not exactly undergoing treatment. I had some blood tests done, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 別に問題はないとのことでしたが
dialogue.English: They said there were no particular issues.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 精密検査をするべきか迷っています
dialogue.English: I'm debating whether I should get a more thorough examination.

dialogue.content: そんな時間をお過ごしだと気持ちが揺れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Going through a time like that would naturally leave you feeling unsettled.

dialogue.content: はい　不安です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm anxious.

dialogue.content: そこでだんだん、結婚のような大きなイベントも不安に思われてしまうのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: And because of that, are you gradually starting to feel anxious about big events like your wedding?

dialogue.content: はい　結婚式もそうですが、その後の不安もでてきています
dialogue.English: Yes, not just the wedding itself, but I'm also starting to worry about what comes after.

dialogue.content: 彼の実家で同居する事になっています
dialogue.English: We're supposed to live with his family.

dialogue.content: なるほど、環境が変わってしまう事も不安ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so the change in environment is also a source of anxiety, isn't it.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんとは話し合えていますか？
dialogue.English: Have you been able to discuss this with your partner?

dialogue.content: まだ　詳しくは話していません
dialogue.English: I haven't talked to him about it in detail yet.

dialogue.content: なんとなく言いづらくて
dialogue.English: It just feels hard to bring up.

dialogue.content: そうですか。。。言いにくい気持になられるのはどうしてでしょう？
dialogue.English: I see... What makes it difficult to talk about?

dialogue.content: 病気がある人と結婚はしたくないと思います
dialogue.English: I think people don't want to marry someone with a health condition.

dialogue.content: 実は
dialogue.English: Actually...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 幼少期に大病を患っていました
dialogue.English: I suffered from a serious illness when I was a child.

dialogue.content: 大きな病気をされたご経験が。。。
dialogue.English: You went through a serious illness...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その時のことを思いだされます
dialogue.English: It's bringing back memories of that time.

dialogue.content: その病気自体は治っているのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Has that illness itself been cured?

dialogue.content: はい　中学からは普通の生活をしていました
dialogue.English: Yes, I've lived a normal life since junior high school.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、苦しいかった小さいころの経験が気持ちに響いて来るんですね。。。お辛いけれど、自然にそんな不安が出てくるのはあることだ思います。
dialogue.English: I see. The difficult experiences from your childhood are resonating with you emotionally now... It must be painful, but I think it's natural for such anxieties to surface.

dialogue.content: 小さい頃に体がダルくて病院に行ったら　即入院となり
dialogue.English: When I was little, I felt sluggish and went to the hospital, and was admitted immediately.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 小学校は　早退をしたり　給食を食べずに帰ったりしていました
dialogue.English: In elementary school, I would often leave early or go home without eating the school lunch.

dialogue.content: 食事制限もあったりで　母親が常に気を使っていました
dialogue.English: I also had dietary restrictions, so my mother was always very careful.

dialogue.content: 治療や体調不良のために、いろいろな苦労をされたんですね。。。ちいさなゆみさんはとても頑張っておられたんですね。。。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you went through many hardships because of your illness and treatment... Little Yumi must have been trying so hard...

dialogue.content: はい　検査結果を聞くのをいつもドキドキしていました
dialogue.English: Yes, I was always nervous waiting for the test results.

dialogue.content: 小さなゆみさんとお母様が手を取り合って病気の不安と闘う姿が目に浮かびます。。。大変なことだったと思います
dialogue.English: I can picture little Yumi and your mother, hand in hand, fighting the anxieties of the illness... It must have been incredibly difficult.

dialogue.content: 今の彼にその当時の事は言ってはいないし、病気があったことも言えてません
dialogue.English: I haven't told my current partner about that time, nor have I told him that I had an illness.

dialogue.content: 話していないんですね、だとするとパートナーさんは「病気のあった人と結婚したくない」と言う考え方だとどうして思われるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You haven't told him. In that case, what makes you think your partner would think, "I don't want to marry someone who's been ill"?

dialogue.content: ゆっくりで大丈夫ですよ、お待ちしてますね
dialogue.English: It's okay to take your time. I'm here for you.

dialogue.content: 普通は健康な人を望むと思います
dialogue.English: I think people normally want a healthy partner.

dialogue.content: 欠陥があると何かと問題がでてくるかと思うのではないですか
dialogue.English: Don't you think they'd worry that if there's a flaw, various problems might arise?

dialogue.content: もし入院にでもなったら　迷惑かけるし
dialogue.English: If I had to be hospitalized, I would be a burden.

dialogue.content: 困ると思います
dialogue.English: I think it would be a problem for him.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そんな風にお考えだったんですね。ゆみさんはとてもしっかりとした相手の立場を思いやる方だと思いました。すばらしいですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's how you've been thinking. It strikes me that you are a very considerate person who thinks deeply about the other person's position. That's wonderful.

dialogue.content: いえ　すばらしいとは思っていないです
dialogue.English: No, I don't think it's wonderful at all.

dialogue.content: 昔から体の事は心配でしたし結婚は不安でした
dialogue.English: I've always been worried about my health, and marriage has always been a source of anxiety.

dialogue.content: 表現がしっくりこなかったらすいません。私には素晴らしく思えました、体調不良の中お相手の方の立場や気持ちを考えてくださっている、なかなかできる事ではありません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if my wording didn't sit right. To me it seemed admirable—thinking about your partner's position and feelings even while you're unwell is not something everyone can do.

dialogue.content: それでもパートナーさんとは結婚の事が不安だ感じていても、今回は飛び込むことができた
dialogue.English: And yet, despite your anxiety about marriage, you were able to take the plunge this time—

dialogue.content: と言う事ですよね
dialogue.English: is that right?

dialogue.content: 結婚後同居ということもあり、不安が続きます
dialogue.English: The fact that we'll be living with his family after marriage adds to my continued anxiety.

dialogue.content: 実は今もまだ迷っています
dialogue.English: To be honest, I'm still having doubts.

dialogue.content: そうですね、結婚後の事も含めてとても迷われていること、ひしひし伝わってきます。。ゆみさんは病気をきっかけとして、いくつもの悩みを一人で抱えてしまっている状態だと思うんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I can strongly sense how conflicted you are, including about life after marriage... I think that with your illness as a trigger, you've found yourself shouldering numerous worries all by yourself.

dialogue.content: 結婚後も含めていろいろなポイントで悩みを抱えていらっしゃる辛さがひしひし伝わってきます。。。
dialogue.English: I can really feel the pain of you struggling with worries at various points, including after the wedding...

dialogue.content: 病気になってしまったら　動けなくなる不安　今の彼はどう対応してくれるか
dialogue.English: If I get sick, I'm afraid I won't be able to function... How would my current partner react?

dialogue.content: もう少し結婚を待ってもらった方がいいかなとか
dialogue.English: ...and I wonder if I should ask him to wait a little longer to get married.

dialogue.content: 今はゆみさんが、たくさんの課題を一人で抱えていらっしゃるので厳しい思いがする状態だと感じています。いくつもの課題を一つづつ一緒に考えて、ゆみさんを応援したいと思っています！
dialogue.English: Right now, I feel that you're in a difficult situation because you're carrying so many challenges alone. I want to help you think through these issues one by one and support you!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます　宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Thank you. I would appreciate that.

dialogue.content: 今おっしゃったように結婚が延期になれば、ゆみさんは少し気持ちが軽くなられますか？
dialogue.English: As you just mentioned, if the wedding were postponed, would that ease your mind a little?

dialogue.content: そうですね　いろんな方に迷惑がかかるのですが、ちょっとは気が楽になると思います
dialogue.English: Yes... it would inconvenience a lot of people, but I think it would ease my mind a little.

dialogue.content: そういった方法も考えられますよね。
dialogue.English: That is one possible option, isn't it.

dialogue.content: えっ
dialogue.English: Oh?

dialogue.content: 可能性としてはどんな方法もあると思うのです、結婚はしても同居はしばらく待つとか
dialogue.English: I think there are all sorts of possibilities. For example, you could get married but wait a while before moving in together.

dialogue.content: 同居の方をですか
dialogue.English: Postpone moving in?

dialogue.content: はい、いろいろな方法は考えられると思います。沢山の家族の形が今はありますから。ただ、ここまでお話を伺って、ゆみさんとパートナーさんには幸せになっていただきたいのですが、その第一歩をまずは踏み出してもらいたいと思っています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think various arrangements are possible. There are many different family structures these days. However, having heard your story, I truly want you and your partner to be happy, and I hope you can take the first step towards that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんにまずは今のゆみさんの気持ちをわかっていただくことが、その第一歩だと思っています。
dialogue.English: I believe the first step is to have your partner understand how you're feeling right now.

dialogue.content: そうですよね　何から伝えたらいいでしょうか
dialogue.English: You're right... What should I start with?

dialogue.content: そこなんです
dialogue.English: That's the key point.

dialogue.content: 今の体調不良の事は伝えないとゆみさんの気持ちが揺らいでいることが伝わらないですよね
dialogue.English: If you don't tell him about your current health issues, he won't understand why you're feeling so conflicted, right?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: 過去の病気の事は言った方がいいですか
dialogue.English: Should I tell him about my past illness?

dialogue.content: ゆみさんとしてはどう思われていますか？
dialogue.English: What are your thoughts on that, Yumi?

dialogue.content: あまり言いたくないです　　親御さんの耳にはいると心配されそうで
dialogue.English: I'd rather not. I'm afraid if his parents hear about it, they'll worry.

dialogue.content: なるほど、その後心配は当然の事ですよね
dialogue.English: I see. It's only natural to be concerned about that.

dialogue.content: 御心配でした
dialogue.English: You're worried about that.

dialogue.content: 子供が産めない体だとか思われたくないし
dialogue.English: I don't want them to think I can't have children or something.

dialogue.content: そんな風に考えておられるんですね。。。私は、今すぐにすべてを言う必要はないと思っています。
dialogue.English: So that's what you've been thinking... I don't believe you need to disclose everything right away.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ただ、いずれ話せる事が出来たら良いなと思っています。
dialogue.English: However, I do hope that you'll be able to talk about it someday.

dialogue.content: そうですね　　今はまだ言わないでおきます
dialogue.English: You're right. I won't say anything for now.

dialogue.content: パートナーさんにまずは「結婚を迷うほど」体調が不安で、体調が不安なことから「結婚式」「結婚後の同居」までできるかどうか不安になっていると言う事から話してみられそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you could start by telling your partner that you're so worried about your health that you're having second thoughts about the wedding, and that because of your health concerns, you're anxious about whether you can go through with the wedding ceremony and living together after marriage?

dialogue.content: はい　その順番で言ってみたらいいですね　　わかりました
dialogue.English: Yes, saying it in that order sounds good. I understand.

dialogue.content: そうしてパートナーさんと話ができると、きっとゆみさんと私が相談しても思いつかなかったような視点も出てくるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: And when you talk with your partner like that, a new perspective might emerge that you and I might not have thought of during our session.

dialogue.content: 思いもつかないような？ことが。。。
dialogue.English: Something... unexpected?

dialogue.content: 彼の出方ですかね
dialogue.English: You mean his reaction?

dialogue.content: 私はパートナーさんのご両親や親せきなどの雰囲気が分からないので。。。意外と同居にはこだわらないとか出てくるかもしれませんよ。そして、くれぐれもご体調の事は病院でしっかり確認されてください。
dialogue.English: I don't know the atmosphere with your partner's parents and relatives... so it might turn out that they aren't insistent on living together, for example. Also, please be sure to get your health checked thoroughly at the hospital.

dialogue.content: ご結婚や、皆さんの生活の変化に対してゆみさんはとても気になってしまうだろうけれど、本当の最優先はお身体の調子を整える事です！
dialogue.English: I'm sure you're very concerned about the wedding and the changes in everyone's lives, but your real top priority is to take care of your health!

dialogue.content: ゆみさんは優しいので、色々な事が気になると思いますが
dialogue.English: Because you're so considerate, many things are bound to weigh on you, but—

dialogue.content: そうですね　　健康が第一ですよね　　　まずは精密検査をしてみます　その後結果を伝えて　話を切り出すのもいいかな
dialogue.English: You're right. Health comes first. I'll get a detailed examination first. Maybe it would be good to tell him the results and then bring up the topic.

dialogue.content: そうですね！本当の最優先はゆみさんのお身体の調子を整える事です！
dialogue.English: Yes! Your real top priority is taking care of your health!

dialogue.content: 今日は　ありがとうございました　親身になってくださって　とても感謝致します
dialogue.English: Thank you so much for today. I'm very grateful that you listened to me so compassionately.

dialogue.content: そして、パートナーさんはゆみさんの体調をきちんと考えてくださるように思います！
dialogue.English: Also, I believe your partner will be truly considerate of your health!

dialogue.content: はい　彼のことを再度確認してみたいと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I would like to confirm that about him again.

dialogue.content: 今日はご相談いただきありがとうございました。そろそろ時間なのですが、話してみてまた迷う事があったらいつでもご相談にいらしてください！
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. Our time is almost up, but if you talk to him and find yourself feeling lost again, please feel free to come back and talk anytime!

dialogue.content: はい　お世話になりました　参考にさせていただきます　お時間ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for your help. I will keep your advice in mind. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: はい！ゆみさんが溌溂と人生を歩んで行けるように応援しています！
dialogue.English: Yes! I'm rooting for you to live a vibrant life, Yumi!

dialogue.content: （ロープレありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play.)

dialogue.content: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.English: (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: （失礼します）
dialogue.English: (Goodbye.)
